source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: بأيام الخريف، رحنا نقطف زيتون ببيارة عمي.
sentences.en: In the fall days, we went to pick olives at my uncle's orchard.

sentences.ar: صحينا بكير لأنه القطاف بدو وقت.
sentences.en: We woke up early because picking takes time.

sentences.ar: فرشنا شراشف تحت الشجر وبلشنا نقطف.
sentences.en: We spread sheets under the trees and started picking.

sentences.ar: الشغل كان تعبان بس الجو كان حلو.
sentences.en: The work was tiring but the weather was nice.

sentences.ar: بوقت الغدا، أكلنا خبز وزيت وزعتر تحت الشجر.
sentences.en: At lunchtime, we ate bread, oil, and za'tar under the trees.

sentences.ar: الولاد كانوا يلعبوا ويجمعوا الزيتون اللي وقع.
sentences.en: The kids were playing and gathering the olives that fell.
At the end of the day, we gathered many bags.
We took the olives to the press to make oil.

sentences.ar: ريحة الزيت الجديد ما في أحلى منها.
sentences.en: There's nothing nicer than the smell of new oil.

sentences.ar: رجعنا تعبانين بس البيت مليان بركة.
sentences.en: We came back tired but the house was full of blessing.
